en.heroIntro: I am Rongqi Lu, an M.Eng. graduate in Control Engineering from Xidian University. My research focuses on multi-robot coordination and multi-agent reinforcement learning: helping agents communicate efficiently and explore reliably in complex environments.
en.beyondResearch: Beyond research, I build AI-assisted development tools and self-hosted infrastructure, and explore edge computing and index-based markets.

zh.heroIntro: 陆荣琦，毕业于西安电子科技大学控制工程专业，获硕士学位。研究聚焦多机器人协同与多智能体强化学习，探索智能体如何在复杂环境中高效通信、可靠决策与自主探索。
zh.beyondResearch: 研究之外，持续实践 AI 辅助开发与自托管基础设施，关注边缘计算、指数化投资与复杂市场中的工程问题。
